text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Marvelous Sunday came walking from down the hallway,
looking unwell...

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: You know... my head is just full of marvelous things.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah. Like a spiky ball is
spinning round and round in your head?"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"Sometimes, deep behind my eyes,
sparks go crackle-crackle, flashing bright..."

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: It feels so painfully funny, it's totally marvelous—ouch, owowow!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems Marvelous Sunday
is suffering from a headache...
